canonicalStep.title: oil-drain-plug-access (BMW 328i draft Engine Oil & Filter Change guide; evidence step 4, 5)

elements.describe: The engine oil drain plug at the underside of the oil pan, drawn as a small plain plug shape.
The small access hatch in the lower undertray near the front-centre of the underside, drawn as a plain rectangular panel with the plug visible through or beside it.
The oil pan as a plain simplified mass around the plug.
Whatever holds the access hatch closed (screws or a coin-operated catch; sources conflict).
The plastic engine (ignition coil) cover; RealOEM and Turner list one for the E90 N52, but its exact shape and fit are not established.
Unestablished detail of hatch fasteners: Sources conflict on how the hatch is fastened.
Unestablished detail of engine cover: An engine cover exists on the N52 but its exact shape is not established; it is left out of the picture.
